_comment: Keys starting with an underscore are notes; amapi.mjs strips them before sending. Placeholders __PACKAGE__, __START_URL__ and __DEVICE_LABEL__ are filled by `amapi.mjs policy-apply`. Why each setting is here: devices/README.md, section 'The policy'.

applications._comment: The RiskMandate app: installed without asking, cannot be removed, updated as soon as Play has a new version. managedConfiguration keys match the app's restrictions (start_url, device_label).
The app opens riskmandate.ai in a Custom Tab, which needs a browser. With playStoreMode WHITELIST only listed apps come from Play, so Chrome is listed to keep it present and updated.

systemUpdate._comment: OS updates only between 02:00 and 05:00 device local time. Per the API the window also applies to Play app updates on the default mode (Chrome here); the RiskMandate app is AUTO_UPDATE_HIGH_PRIORITY, which has no constraints.
